messages.subject: Re: shiny routing change
parts:
hey trung, 
it seems you have an app (directory) named 7081, which resides under a directory named p - both reside in the shiny server's apps directory (as defined in your configuration file).
if you want the index url to show an app, simply create a shiny app and save it as index under the p directory.
if you want an index html page (which will be displayed when you access the server), simply add an index.html file to your apps directory (p's parent directory).

additional information regarding this case can be found here.
